0.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1SUB3_00574_SUEREND_100_001
0.description: I imagine you were quite concerned for the future of the Bellows, what with the forge being manned by these dullards. But you need not fear, now that Sue-Rend is here!
0.translation_description: Immagino ti preoccupasse il futuro delle Iron Bellows, con quella banda di teste di legno alla fucina. Ma ora che c'è Sue-Rend, non hai più nulla da temere!

1.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1SUB3_00574_SUEREND_000_001
1.description: Keep those tasks coming. More work, I say!
1.translation_description: Continua a passarmi incarichi. Più lavoro, dico io!
